stories.title: Google to Invest $15 Billion on AI Infrastructure in Finland
stories.simple_summary: Google is spending 15 billion dollars to build powerful computer equipment in Finland to run AI systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech workers — nothing you need to act on right now.

stories.title: UNT to open new college of artificial intelligence with $20 million gift
stories.simple_summary: A university is creating a new school focused on artificial intelligence, funded by a 20 million dollar donation.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly news for students interested in AI education — it doesn't affect your daily life or business.

stories.title: US allies lack resources to keep pace on AI, top Pentagon official says
stories.simple_summary: A top military official says the United States' partner countries don't have enough money and resources to keep up with America's AI development.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to government and military planners — nothing you need to worry about as a business owner.

stories.title: Anthropic safety researcher says more than 10% chance AI 'could kill all humans'
stories.simple_summary: A researcher at an AI company says there's a small but real chance (more than 10%) that advanced AI could become very dangerous to humanity in the future.
stories.why_it_matters: This is an honest worry from experts, but it's about distant future risks — for now, focus on current AI tools that can help your business.

stories.title: Google to invest $15 billion in AI infrastructure and buy nuclear power in Finland
stories.simple_summary: Google is spending 15 billion dollars on computer equipment in Finland and also buying nuclear power plants to run it all.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Google to Invest $15 Billion in Data Centers and Infrastructure in Finland
stories.simple_summary: Google is spending 15 billion dollars to build large computer centers in Finland that will power AI systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech workers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: OpenAI claims to have solved maths problem that stumped humans for decades
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI's AI solved a math problem that has stumped mathematicians for about 90 years.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI is getting better at hard thinking tasks, but it's mainly impressive to mathematicians and engineers — you don't need to act on this.

stories.title: Hackers are stealing Claude tokens from subscribers
stories.simple_summary: Hackers have figured out how to steal AI credits from people's Claude accounts without permission, like thieves stealing from a wallet.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Claude AI, you should check your account activity regularly and consider protecting your login information, just like you would with email or banking.

stories.title: Cognition hits $48B valuation, signaling investors believe AI coding is far from a winner-take-all market
stories.simple_summary: An AI company called Cognition is now valued at 48 billion dollars, showing investors think AI coding tools are valuable.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — it doesn't directly affect your business unless you use AI coding tools.

stories.title: OpenAI says it cracked 90-year-old maths problem in 88 hours
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI's AI solved a 90-year-old math problem in just 88 hours.
stories.why_it_matters: This mainly impresses mathematicians and engineers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Drama swirls around OpenAI’s legendary mathematical milestone
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI announced that its AI found an answer to a famous math problem called the Navier-Stokes problem that scientists have been stuck on for roughly 90 years.
stories.why_it_matters: This is impressive but mostly matters to mathematicians and scientists — it doesn't affect your daily life or business.

stories.title: ChatGPT Sketch turns your bad drawings into detailed AI images
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI added a new drawing tool to ChatGPT where you can sketch something rough and the AI will turn it into a detailed picture.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use ChatGPT, you can now create images by drawing simple doodles instead of typing descriptions — useful if you're making marketing materials or designs.
